On %1$s:

1. Press Home on the TV remote.
2. Open Apps or Your apps.
3. Select ConfluenceTV.
4. Sign in with the same mobile number used during registration.
5. Enter the OTP received on your mobile.
6. Keep the TV app open until activation is confirmed.

After successful TV activation and OTP verification, your ₹170 installation reward can be credited. Continue using ConfluenceTV to earn daily rewards.

Rewards are subject to successful verification and campaign eligibility.
